skills.description: Generate bilingual Chinese–English research review documents (secondary research with independent analytical contribution) from a user-supplied topic. Produces literature-grounded reviews with 述评结合 (evidence + critical comparison), comparison tables, and a forward-looking Outlook section covering gaps and future directions. Writing quality is calibrated against Nature Reviews journals, Science review articles, and other high-impact review venues. Supports four review types: Comprehensive/Narrative, State-of-the-Art (SOTA), Systematic Review (PRISMA-compliant), and Critical/Perspective Review. Use for biomedical, biotech, AI, CS, engineering, or interdisciplinary fields when the deliverable must include verified citations, Markdown source, formatted Word documents (.docx), and a literature spreadsheet (.xlsx). Make sure to use this skill whenever the user asks for a literature review, research survey, comprehensive overview, review paper, or systematic review, even if they phrase it as "write a review on", "summarize the field of", "give an overview of", "survey the literature on", "写一篇综述", "文献综述", or "撰写XX研究进展综述". Do NOT use this skill for simple searches, short answer questions, lookup requests such as "查一下XX研究进展", or tasks that do not require a full review document with cited references.
skills.description_zh: 文献综述生成器（review-generator ）是一个从用户给定主题自动生成中英双语研究综述的 AI 技能，产出以证据为根基、带可核验引文的综述文档，写作质量对标 Nature Reviews、Science 综述与 Annual Reviews 等顶刊标准。它将综述定位为带有独立分析贡献的二次研究，要求对文献做述评结合而非成果罗列，支持综合叙事型、领域前沿型、系统综述型（PRISMA 合规）与批判视角型四类综述。技能内置多数据库文献检索、六维加权评分筛选与深析框架，终章统一为 Outlook 与展望，采用 Vancouver 顺序制引文并中英共享一套编号，最终交付包含 Markdown、Word 与文献清单表格的完整成果包。为保障质量，技能引入对抗式修订五步回路、SANRA 叙述性综述量评、中文 AI 腔禁用清单、自引失衡校验，以及仿 Nature Reviews 的 Key points 与 Boxes，文献密度接近顶刊每千词约 25 条引用水平，使生成的综述兼具学术严谨性与科学性。由于需要文献检索和分析，撰写时间会在1h左右。
skills.name: 文献综述生成器
